text: In 2023 Dufry acquired Autogrill: on 1 July 2023 Dufry said it would hold 96.3858% of Autogrill's share capital and could start the squeeze-out, which would leave it holding all of Autogrill's shares, and delist Autogrill. Dufry AG has since been renamed Avolta AG, and Autogrill is one of Avolta's dining brands.
short: Autogrill was acquired and delisted by Dufry, now Avolta AG, in 2023.
